# PerchTV 0.1.29

A steadier pairing list on Android TV.

## WHAT CHANGED

- On Android TV, unpairing every phone while another phone's command is arriving can no longer bring a removed pairing back after a restart.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Samsung televisions: the same as 0.1.28 apart from the version number. Captions and spoken guidance on both televisions, a film that ends, ends, and up to eight phones.
